classes.2da._description: Character classes — Soldier, Scout, Scoundrel, Jedi prestige classes, etc.
classes.2da.label: Internal class name (do not edit unless you know what you're doing).
classes.2da.name: StrRef into dialog.tlk for the display name.
classes.2da.hitdie: HP die per level. Vanilla: Soldier 10, Scout 8, Scoundrel 6. Set to 20 for d20 HP.
classes.2da.forcedie: Force Points per level. Non-Jedi classes are 0.
classes.2da.attackbonustable: Lookup into cls_atk_*.2da — BAB progression. high/mid/low.
classes.2da.savingthrowtable: Lookup into cls_savthr_*.2da — saving throw progression.
classes.2da.skillpointbase: Base skill points per level. Soldier 2, Scout 4, Scoundrel 8.
classes.2da.skillstable: Lookup into cls_skill_*.2da — which skills are class skills.
classes.2da.featstable: Lookup into cls_feat_*.2da — class feat list.
classes.2da.spellgaintable: Lookup into cls_pwrgn_*.2da — Force power gain per level (Jedi only).
classes.2da.spellknowntable: Lookup into cls_pwrkn_*.2da — Force powers known.
classes.2da.playerclass: 1 = selectable on character creation, 0 = NPC / prestige only.
classes.2da.str: Default starting Strength for NPC versions of this class.

feat.2da._description: All feats. Combat feats, skill feats, Jedi class feats, etc.
feat.2da.label: Internal feat name.
feat.2da.prereqfeat1: Required feat row ID (or **** for none).
feat.2da.successor: Feat row that supersedes this one (e.g. Improved → Master).
feat.2da.category: Feat category for the UI grouping.

spells.2da.label: Internal power name.
spells.2da.name: Display name StrRef.
spells.2da.impactscript: ResRef of the script that runs on impact (where damage/effects live).

baseitems.2da._description: Item categories — lightsabers, blasters, armor classes, etc.
baseitems.2da.label: Category name.
baseitems.2da.name: Display name StrRef.
baseitems.2da.dietoroll: Damage die size (e.g. 6 for d6). Combined with weapondice gives base damage.
baseitems.2da.acbonus: Bonus AC on top of base.
baseitems.2da.dexbonus: Max Dex bonus permitted by this armor.

exptable.2da._description: XP required for each character level.
exptable.2da.xp: Total XP needed to reach this level. Edit to make levelling faster/slower.

skills.2da.label: Internal skill name.
skills.2da.name: Display name StrRef.
skills.2da.armorcheckpenalty: 1 = armor check penalty applies to this skill.

appearance.2da._description: Creature appearance models. Used by .utc files.
appearance.2da.label: Internal appearance name.
appearance.2da.modeltype: Model rig type (F=full creature, P=parts-based PC).
appearance.2da.hasarms: Whether the model has arms (affects weapon equip).
